title: Local model scan paths discovered, not configured
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. local_scan_paths derived from the ecosystem scan (engine stores, HF cache, common download dirs) with no list to maintain. Tests zc_scan_paths_*.
